name: Lint Suppression Guard
summary: Block net-new broad diagnostic suppressions while allowing scoped rule exceptions.
description: Compares bounded source revisions and rejects new ESLint, Python, Go, and IDE suppressions that name no rule and new TypeScript @ts-ignore or @ts-nocheck directives, while allowing directives that name a rule.
risk_reason: This automatic gate blocks net-new broad diagnostic suppressions while allowing scoped rule exceptions; a false denial can interrupt legitimate work, but it does not execute the blocked action.
refuses: It does not decide whether a named diagnostic is correct.
It does not block removal or narrowing of an existing suppression.
It does not govern test skips or focused tests.

entrypoints.purpose: Block net-new broad diagnostic suppressions while allowing scoped rule exceptions.

operational.latency_reason: The entrypoint handles one intercepted event to block net-new broad diagnostic suppressions while allowing scoped rule exceptions without deferred work.
